# Vendored third-party audio

## resonance-audio.min.js — Resonance Audio SDK for Web (v1.0.0)
Copyright 2018 Google LLC · Apache License 2.0 · https://github.com/resonance-audio/resonance-audio-web-sdk
Vendored verbatim (no modifications). Renders the DJ booth's dance-hall ring
as an Ambisonic soundfield. If this file is removed, Home Binger falls back
to the built-in Web Audio ring automatically.
